name: Helping the Hotties
source:
In [b]Helping the Hotties[/b], you are a psychology college student, ready to finally spend the summer with your [b]super hot girlfriend[/b]. But, instead of spending the summer with her, you receive an unexpected phone call... 

The next morning, you're on a bus going to [b]work at a behavioral rehabilitation camp[/b]. And as you'll soon learn, this year will be different...

Your goal is to lead a group of [b]four beautiful attendees[/b] through their journey of self-improvement and reintegration into society while trying to remain as professional as possible... and maintain a long-distance relationship.

It might prove more challenging than you expect. Every girl has a different personality, her own whims and wants and it's up to you to [b]keep them satisfied[/b]. 

Are you up for the task while under the watchful gaze of the head camp counselor, Eve? She has her eye on you. And she's not the only one!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1590730/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在[b]帮助辣妹[/b]中，你是一名心理学大学生，准备好与你的[b]超级性感女友[/b]一起度过夏天。但是，你没有和她一起度过夏天，而是接到了一个意想不到的电话…… 

第二天早上，你乘坐巴士前往[b]行为康复营工作[/b]。你很快就会了解到，今年将会有所不同……

你的目标是带领[b]四位美丽的参与者[/b]完成自我完善和重新融入社会的旅程，同时努力保持尽可能的专业……并保持远距离关系。

这可能比你预期的更具挑战性。每个女孩都有不同的个性，她自己的奇思妙想和想要的东西，这取决于你[b]让她们满意[/b]。

你准备好在营地辅导员夏娃的注视下完成这项任务了吗？她的目光注视着你。而且她不是唯一一个！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1590730/]Steam[/url]]
